logline: 溪岸不催你對抗。它只讓水流過來。
youtubeTitle: [playlist] QuietLY · 溪岸聽順 — Slow Mandarin Jazz

comics.en: The bank does not ask you to fight.
It only lets the water come.
Bend a little, wait a little, keep up.
The current already knows the way.
